t: A machine used to $(6)kill$() mobs as if a player would producing drops and Essence. Drops are directly created from the mob lootpool. $(br2)This machine has an alternate mode where instead of generating essence it will generate drops with random levels of $(6)fortune$().
一种用于$(6)击杀$()生物的机器，其效果如同玩家手动击杀，可正常掉落战利品与精华。掉落物直接源自对应生物的战利品表。$(br2)该机器具备备用模式：此时不生成精华，而是生成带有随机$(6)幸运$()等级的掉落物。
